31924-VII.s: This is the 2009 slotwet (final budget adjustment act) for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations' 2008 budget, changing the departmental budget statement and the statement for service units operating on a baten-lasten basis. It sets the adjusted 2008 amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and the budget statement for service units operating on a baten-lasten basis of this ministry, both for the year 2008.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII)

31965-IXB.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) following the Spring Memorandum, adjusting appropriations and receipts across tax, financial markets and other articles. The explanatory memorandum details budgetary effects such as the deposit scheme interest adjustment, export subsidy correction, and increased supervisory contributions to the AFM and DNB.
31965-IXB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the Spring Memorandum, a court ruling of the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven, and European Commission corrections, not by any delegation of power.
q: As a result of a ruling by the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven, costs such as preparing laws and regulations cannot be passed on to the sector.
Als gevolg van een uitspraak van het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven kunnen de kosten van o.a. voorbereiding van wet- en regelgeving niet worden doorberekend aan de sector.

32213-(R1903).s: The bill amends the Statute for the Kingdom of the Netherlands to give Curaçao and Sint Maarten the status of countries within the Kingdom, to make Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba part of the Dutch state structure, and to dissolve the Netherlands Antilles as a country. It also adds transitional provisions allowing the islands' draft constitutions and regulations to acquire legal force and creates a basis for regulating disputes between the countries.
32213-(R1903).j: The memorandum justifies the special measures for the three islands by their economic, social, geographic and insular circumstances, and says any such measure will be motivated and tested against subsidiarity and proportionality.
q: Rules may be set and other specific measures taken for these islands in view of economic and social circumstances.
Voor deze eilanden kunnen regels worden gesteld en andere specifieke maatregelen worden getroffen met het oog op de economische en sociale omstandigheden
d: special rules and measures for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba
arrangements for resolving disputes between Kingdom and countries by national law
general national administrative measure implementing treaties where country regulation is missing
inter-country arrangements for handling mutual disputes
p: Allows a general national administrative measure, not a law, to determine how treaty obligations are implemented in a country when that country's regulation is missing.
Gives draft constitutions and regulations adopted by island councils legal force upon entry into force, with the Kingdom government's consent as a condition for constitutions.

parties: Asks how long the BES islands can function without a constitutional basis and when the Statute will be fully modernised.
Can the BES islands' construction as public bodies survive this long without a constitutional basis, ask the CDA members.
Kan de constructie van de BES-eilanden als openbaar lichaam zo lang zonder Grondwettelijke basis voortbestaan, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Asks about the timing of the Grondwet amendment, the procedure under Article 55(3) of the Statute, and whether the BES islands keep the option to leave the Kingdom.
Does the government assume that Article 55(3) of the Statute does not apply to this bill, so that a second reading is not needed?
Gaat de regering ervan uit dat artikel 55, derde lid, van het Statuut niet van toepassing is bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en een behandeling in tweede lezing dus niet nodig is?
Objects that island councils are only consulted rather than asked to consent, and questions the vague scope of Article 43 and the open-ended exceptions to equality.
Supports pragmatism but finds the Statute outdated; warns that the open-ended deviation ground risks arbitrariness and that the law-enforcement chain must be in order before transition.
Asks whether the open-ended deviation clause could allow cultural or moral rules to override equality and rights protections.
In other words, does this provision offer protection against the immediate and forced imposition of a modern secular morality?
Biedt deze bepaling met andere woorden bescherming tegen het onmiddellijk en geforceerd opleggen van een moderne, geseculariseerde moraal
Questions whether the proposed deviation clause permits departure from the Grondwet and whether the chosen procedure bypasses the two-thirds majority needed for constitutional amendment.
Under this provision, is it also possible to deviate from the Constitution?
Is het op basis van deze bepaling ook mogelijk om af te wijken van de Grondwet
Argues the internal appeal procedure gives the Dutch prime minister decisive weight and proposes a unanimity requirement to reduce the Kingdom-level democratic deficit.
Because the structure of the internal appeal makes the view of the prime minister, as chair of the Kingdom Council of Ministers, decisive in that procedure.
Immers, de structuur van het intern appèl maakt dat de mening van de minister-president als voorzitter van de ministerraad van het Koninkrijk in die procedure doorslaggevend is.
Says the internal appeal lacks adequate safeguards and proposes a Constitutional Court or arbitration court to settle disputes between the Kingdom and the countries.
Under the internal appeal as currently prescribed in Article 12 of the Charter, there is in fact no procedure surrounded by sufficient safeguards.
Bij het intern appèl, zoals thans voorgeschreven in artikel 12 van het Statuut, is er feitelijk geen sprake van een met voldoende waarborgen omklede procedure.

Asks that the explanatory memorandum state the period of conflict with the Charter must be no longer than strictly necessary for legal certainty, and prefers a more democratic form of dispute settlement.
Can it still be included in the explanatory memorandum that, for legal certainty and sound governance, the period of conflict with the Charter may not last longer than strictly necessary?

Kan alsnog in de onderhavige Memorie van Toelichting worden opgenomen dat in het kader van de rechtszekerheid en deugdelijkheid van bestuur de periode van strijdigheid met het Statuut niet langer mag duren dan strikt noodzakelijk is?

Contends that the bill's provisions embedding Bonaire in the Dutch state with unlimited deviation factors undermine island autonomy and conflict with the referendum outcome and the European Convention on Human Rights.

By embedding Bonaire as a public body under Article 134 of the Dutch constitution within the Dutch state and by including unlimited deviation factors, Bonaire becomes, in the firm view of Statenlid Nicolaas, a constitutional appendix of the European part of the Kingdom.

Door Bonaire als openbaar lichaam conform artikel 134 van de Nederlandse grondwet binnen het staatsbestel van Nederland in te bedden en door de opname van ongelimiteerde afwijkingsfactoren, wordt Bonaire naar de stellige mening van het Statenlid Nicolaas een «constitutionele appendix» van het Europese deel van het Koninkrijk.
Wants an independent body to resolve strictly legal disputes over interpretation of the Statuut, and objects that the proposed article 38a adds nothing and is non-binding.

If the aim is to create an adequate arrangement for independent resolution of disputes over legal interpretation of the Statuut provisions agreed jointly by the three countries, the countries must now clearly commit in advance to cooperate under article 12a.](Note: translation of Dutch sentence above)

Wil er sprake zijn van het scheppen van een adequate voorziening voor een onafhankelijke beslechting van geschillen over de juridische interpretatie van de door de drie landen gezamenlijk overeengekomen Statutaire bepalingen, dan moet nu duidelijk blijken dat de landen zich bij voorbaat committeren om op grond van artikel 12a mee te werken

Wants new Kingdom laws with far-reaching effects to require two-thirds approval of the Staten, a withdrawal clause in every Rijkswet, and a referendum before the amendment takes effect; opposes the article 27 enforcement mechanism as eroding Aruba's autonomy.
New Rijkswetten, or amendments to existing ones with far-reaching consequences, may not be adopted before the draft has been approved by the Staten by two-thirds of votes cast.[translation]

Nieuwe rijkswetten dan wel wijziging van bestaande rijkswetten met verstrekkende gevolgen, worden niet vastgesteld alvorens het ontwerp door de Staten is goedgekeurd met twee derden der uitgebrachte stemmen.

Questions whether the third paragraph of article 27 is necessary given existing powers under articles 43 and 51, and urges that 'kunnen' in articles 12a and 38a be replaced by 'zullen' so that a more democratic dispute procedure is actually required.

The P.D.R. faction suggests replacing the word 'kunnen' in articles 12a and 38a of the draft with 'zullen', so that a more democratic form of dispute resolution must replace the current internal appeal procedure.[translation]
De P.D.R.-fractie geeft tenslotte in overweging om het woord «kunnen» opgenomen in artikelen 12a en 38a van het ontwerp, te vervangen door het woord «zullen»

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft Rijkswet amending the Statute for the Kingdom to dissolve the Netherlands Antilles, make Curaçao and Sint Maarten countries and incorporate Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba into the Dutch state, advising several revisions (new structure wording, BES-island position, treaty implementation, transition timing and elections). The government's nader rapport largely accepts the Raad's points, keeps the structural article I but adds clarifications, and commits to timely passage by mid-2010.
concerns: The Raad advised dropping the article I statement of the new structure as unnecessary, but the government kept it, arguing fundamental constitutional changes warrant explicit regulation in the Statute.

The Raad advised shortening the interim period before the BES islands' constitutional anchoring in the Grondwet; the government did not start a constitutional revision now and left the timing to the Dutch organs.

The Raad advised clarifying the differentiation clause in article 1(2) on equality grounds for the BES islands, and the government added explanation of its role as an instruction to legislator, administration and judge.
The Raad advised that article 27(3) on implementing treaties be explained given existing article 51, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
The Raad urged timely completion of the transition and legislation by mid-2010, and the government agreed to pursue it without committing to a specific timetable beyond that.
The Raad advised on extending or advancing the Antillean Staten elections; the government noted the Antillean government had decided to hold the January 2010 elections, making the point moot.

32500-VIII.s: The bill sets the 2011 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the baten-lastendienst budgets for DUO and the Nationaal Archief, in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January 2011. The explanatory memorandum excerpts describe policy goals, instruments and budget allocations rather than delegations of rule-making power.
q: Establishment of the budget statement for the baten-lastendienst accompanying the Act of
Vaststelling van de Begrotingsstaat inzake de baten-lastendienst behorende bij de Wet van

32710-XV.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget of its baten-lastendiensten (agency with accrual accounting), giving effect to the first and second supplementary budgets and final budget adjustments. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33400-VIII.s: The bill fixes the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the operating-cost budgets of DUO and the National Archives, in thousands of euros. It also sets a multi-year budget reserve under Apparaatskosten, departing from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for 2013.
33400-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget reserve as an administrative-efficiency measure pending a general statutory provision in a future revision of the Comptabiliteitswet.
q: Notwithstanding Article 5(4) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, a multi-year budget reserve charged to the non-policy article Apparaatskosten (article 95) is maintained for 2013.

In afwijking van artikel 5, vierde lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt voor het jaar 2013 een meerjarige begrotingsreserve ten laste van het niet-beleidsartikel Apparaatskosten (artikel 95) aangehouden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against Article 3 of the 2013 budget bill for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, which would allow a multi-year budget reserve to be charged to the non-policy Apparatus costs article, arguing budget laws must stay limited to revenue and expenditure and that the required justification was missing. The minister's reply accepts that the reserve conflicts with the Comptabiliteitswet, keeps the temporary deviation pending a structural statutory fix, and adds the requested explanation to the memorandum.
concerns: Article 3 deviates from the Comptabiliteitswet and budget laws should not contain such provisions; the minister keeps the temporary deviation pending a general statutory arrangement in the planned revision of the Comptabiliteitswet.
The memorandum lacked the required explanation of motives, size, and expected additions or withdrawals for the reserve, and the minister added an explanation on the Apparatus article.

33605-XII.s: This bill (Slotwet 2012) amends the 2012 budget statutes of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment and its agencies, adjusting expenditure, revenue and commitment figures to realised outcomes. It contains only technical and bookkeeping adjustments, with no new delegations or changes to executive powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation adjustments, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

33805-VII.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations, the Ministry for Housing and Central Government Affairs, and their agencies, through a second supplementary budget adjusting spending, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 December 2013 with retroactive effect to 1 June 2013 if the Staatsblad is published later.
33805-VII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the extra costs of the 2014 municipal elections abroad, the Experimentenwet, simplified voting procedures for overseas voters and exploring electronic voting, not by any delegation of power.
q: These are extra costs that must be incurred for the 2014 municipal elections at the Dutch Representations in Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
Het gaat daarbij om extra kosten die moeten worden gemaakt voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2014 bij de Nederlandse Vertegenwoordigingen in Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten.

33940-VII.s: The bill amends the 2014 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) and the related agency budget, shifting spending and revenue amounts in thousands of euros, including a cut of 70,000 thousand euros to the VUT fund. It takes effect on 1 June 2014 with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII), and of the budget statement for the agency of this ministry, for the year 2014.

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII), en van de begrotingsstaat inzake het agentschap van dit ministerie alle voor het jaar 2014.

34300-VIII.s: This bill sets the 2016 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the agency budget statements for DUO and Nationaal Archief, in thousands of euros. It also sets entry into force on 1 January 2016 with retroactive effect where publication is late.
q: The budget statement for the year 2016 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34550-XII.s: This bill establishes the 2017 budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, including departmental expenditure and receipts totaling about 7.9 billion euros, and the budget statements for its executive agencies. The accompanying explanatory memorandum sets out policy goals and budget allocations across the ministry's policy articles, including water, roads, rail, aviation, shipping, climate, environment and enforcement via the ILT inspectorate.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment for the year 2017, attached to this law, is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34730-XII.s: This bill amends the 2017 first supplementary budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment and of its executive agencies, adjusting appropriations and expenditures across policy articles. It also sets the effective date of the amendments and states the amounts are in thousands of euros.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment (XII).
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (XII)

34775-IX.s: This bill fixes the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes spending, revenue, risk guarantees, tax enforcement and oversight arrangements, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this law for the year 2018 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

35000-XIII.s: This bill sets the 2019 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and the 2019 budget statements for its executive agencies, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum excerpts cover budget items, agency funding, planned telecom ownership legislation and climate and energy policy, with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for the year 2019 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35106-(R2115).s: The bill amends the Dutch Rijkswet Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid (Safety Board) on several points, including its ministerial responsibility, membership size and terms, staff status, and the rules for investigators and confidentiality. It also adds obligations on responses to recommendations under EU regulation 996/2010 and extends the Board's powers when it assists investigations by other states, while dropping the planned lifting of the restriction on investigating public-order incidents.
35106-(R2115).j: The memorandum justifies the changes on grounds of legal certainty, alignment with EU regulation, and consistency with the Wet veiligheidsonderzoeken, and drops the public-order investigation extension after the Council of State's advice.
q: The Council of State's advisory division concludes that the lifting of the investigation restriction should be abandoned.
De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State verbindt hieraan de conclusie dat van het opheffen van de onderzoeksbeperking zou moeten worden afgezien.
d: rules on legal position of board members and staff
p: Artikel I, A.1 and G, H, J, K
Ministerial responsibility for the Board is moved from the Minister of Justice to the Minister of Justice and Security or Interior Affairs, with routine reassignment of references.
Artikel I, O and P (Articles 73 and 74)
Addressees of safety recommendations must respond to the Board within 90 days, strengthening the Board's position against executive bodies.
The Board's investigative powers and confidentiality regime are explicitly extended to participation in investigations by other states or Aruba, Curacao and Sint Maarten.
Several articles on the Board's earlier provisions are repealed, removing existing provisions without a clear replacement in the bill text.
Artikel I, E.2 and F and I (Articles 11, 13, 32)
Staff and external contractors are given investigative powers and the protections of Board staff, and the Board's own terms and roles are adjusted.

parties: The CDA asks the government to answer the Council of State's principled objections that extending the Safety Board into public order shifts accountability to local, municipal responsibilities.
Can the government indicate how it intends to address these principled objections of the Council of State, which clearly go further than merely the lack of motivation, the CDA members ask?

Kan de regering aangeven hoe zij van plan is tegemoet te komen aan deze principiële bezwaren van deAfdeling, die duidelijk verder strekken dan enkel het ontbreken van een motivatie, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised against proceeding with the bill extending the Onderzoeksraad voor veiligheid's investigative remit to public order incidents, finding the need unmotivated, the public-order domain fundamentally different, and local democratic accountability and administrative complexity at risk. The government's reply withdraws the public-order extension from the bill, while stating it does not definitively abandon the idea and will consult municipalities first.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the necessity of conferring the new public-order investigative task on the Onderzoeksraad is not motivated; the government accepts the justification is insufficient and drops the provision from the bill, but does not definitively abandon it.

The unlimited, undefined scope of public-order investigations would let the Onderzoeksraad examine almost any local incident, a principled and disproportionate extension that the explanatory memorandum does not justify.
Extending the remit shifts accountability from municipal authorities (mayor and council) toward the Minister and parliament, undermining decentralised democratic accountability for public order.

Administrative complexity and overlap with existing inspectorates and the Openbaar Ministerie would increase, and the explanatory memorandum addresses this only through future coordination protocols rather than a prior weighing of interests.

35200-VIII.s: This Slotwet (final budget act) amends the 2018 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budgets of the agencies DUO and Nationaal Archief, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts to realised figures. It does not delegate rule-making power, shift powers between branches, or create emergency or oversight changes.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for 2018
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35450-XII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat and the budget of its executive agencies (RWS, ILT, KNMI), raising appropriations and shifting funds between years. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive discretion, and no changes to oversight or judicial review.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have found fit and resolved, as We hereby find fit and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

35470-VII.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (slotwet) that adjusts the 2019 budget statements of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations and its agencies to match realised spending and revenue. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no power shifts toward the executive, and no explanatory memorandum text.
q: We have deemed it necessary to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for 2019.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII)

35650-VII.s: This second supplementary budget amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles such as housing, energy transition and Groningen. The bill itself only sets amounts and effective dates and does not delegate rule-making or shift powers between institutions.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2020
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2020

35830-VII.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statements (Slotwet) of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and of its agencies, adjusting appropriations and realised figures in thousands of euros. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no shift of power to the executive, and its explanatory memorandum is absent from the text.
q: We have found and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2020 is amended

Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

36100-VIII.s: This is a supplementary budget act (Slotwet) for 2021 that amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statements of the DUO and National Archives agencies, recording realised spending against the adopted budget. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and only fixes budget amounts in thousands of euros with a retroactive entry-into-force clause.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for 2021 is amended.
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd

36350-XII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (HXII) and the budget statement for its agencies, including Rijkswaterstaat and KNMI. The bill raises or lowers appropriations across policy articles, mainly to fund the Stint damages settlement after a Council of State ruling.
36350-XII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need to pay Stint damages following a Council of State ruling, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: This concerns the funds needed for the damages settlement for the use of the Stint to comply with the Council of State ruling.
Dit betreft de benodigde middelen voor de schaderegeling voor het gebruik van de Stint om gehoor te geven aan de uitspraak van de Raad van State.

36550-VII.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, adjusting expenditure and commitments across policy articles such as housing, energy and the Binnenhof renovation. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2024.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2024

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2024

36613-VII.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (supplementary budget, September), raising spending and commitment ceilings across policy articles such as housing and central administration. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 17 September 2024.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36640-(R2201).s: The bill amends the Rijkswet consulaire bescherming EU-burgers to add a chapter under which the Minister issues EU emergency travel documents to non-represented EU citizens and their family members in third countries, within seven working days. It sets validity limits, data-retention rules and related definitions to implement Directive (EU) 2019/997.
36640-(R2201).j: The memorandum justifies the seven-working-day issuance term and its possible deviation as already practice and as permitted by the EU directive, without invoking new executive discretion.
q: The Minister issues an EU emergency travel document as soon as possible, but no later than seven working days after receipt of the application.
Onze Minister geeft een EU-noodreisdocument zo spoedig mogelijk af, maar uiterlijk zeven werkdagen na ontvangst van de aanvraag.

parties: Asks how coordination between member states and embassy capacity are ensured to prevent errors and external pressure, and how misuse by non-EU family members is prevented.
Welcomes the amendment and has no questions.
These members have no further questions about the amendment.
Deze leden hebben verder geen vragen over de wetswijziging.
Supports further study into replacing national emergency travel documents with a uniform EU document and asks whether other member states would join.
These members ask the government whether it will include in this study the question of whether other member states would join this initiative.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij in dit onderzoek de vraag wil meenemen of andere lidstaten zich bij dit initiatief zouden willen aansluiten.
Asks for justification of the 180-day data retention period, the scope of facultative issuance to family members, and the reasons for delayed implementation, including a motion by Van der Lee.
Which of these two grounds mainly determines that the 180-day period was chosen, and how was the 180 days arrived at, the aforementioned members ask.
Welke van deze twee gronden bepaalt vooral dat de termijn van 180 dagen is gekozen en hoe komt men tot die 180 dagen, zo vragen de voornoemde leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing the EU emergency travel document directive should include the directive's maximum retention periods for personal data and align the definition of non-represented EU citizen with the directive. The minister's reply states both points were adopted by adding article 5f and amending article 5b, and clarifies data use and the Caribbean part of the Kingdom.
concerns: Retention periods for personal data, which the directive sets as maximums, were not implemented in the bill; the Council advised implementing them, and the minister added article 5f with 180-day and two-year periods.
The definition of non-represented EU citizen in article 5b(1)(a) omitted the directive's alternative ground of inability to provide consular protection; the minister added this to article 5b(1)(b).

36800-XII.s: This bill sets the 2026 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and the agency budgets for Rijkswaterstaat and the KNMI, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes policy roles, planned activities and Deltafonds cross-references across water, roads, transport, aviation, environment and inspection.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2026 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Waterstaat (XII) and raised no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, sent on behalf of the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat, notes that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in attachments not included in the text.

36820-VII.s: The bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the agency budgets via a September supplementary budget, including reallocations for Groningen and central apparatus. It sets budget figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 16 September 2025.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations for the year 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.
